purpose: provide one interpretable high-level dossier that explains which ODSP forecast trust gates passed, which failed, and which deployment warnings apply without collapsing validation, calibration, uncertainty, novelty or selection into a single confidence score

data_role_separation.validation_candidate: already-computed robust trust-aware candidate score from untouched validation rows
data_role_separation.model_selection: optional robust trust-aware comparison result computed only from validation evidence
data_role_separation.deployment_novelty_rows: optional novelty summaries for new forecast/query rows; these never alter validation evidence

blocking_reason_rules.point_transfer_failure: point transfer category is not generalizing
blocking_reason_rules.groupwise_coverage_failure: one or more independent groups fail declared empirical coverage tolerance
blocking_reason_rules.transfer_uncertain: one or more block-bootstrap gain intervals cross zero
blocking_reason_rules.transfer_nonpositive: block-bootstrap evidence is robustly non-positive or mixed
blocking_reason_rules.transfer_unavailable: robust transfer cannot be estimated because the declared block gate fails

known_truth_dossiers.robust_in_domain: robustly trusted validation plus in-domain deployment, no blockers or warnings
known_truth_dossiers.fragile_in_domain: point/coverage trusted but block-bootstrap uncertain, blocked despite in-domain deployment
known_truth_dossiers.coverage_failed_in_domain: robust transfer but group-wise coverage failure, blocked
known_truth_dossiers.robust_strict_extrapolation: robustly trusted validation retained, deployment status is strict extrapolation warning
known_truth_dossiers.too_few_blocks: point/coverage trusted but transfer uncertainty unavailable, validation status unavailable
